rationale: The packet supports that Cadmium has no enforceable numeric discharge limit in any column (all N/A or Report) and requires quarterly grab sampling. However, the obligation also asks whether the Report entry under the 7-DAY AVG concentration column obligates reporting or evaluating a 7-day average concentration despite Grab sample type, or instead only quarterly grab-sample results with no numeric compliance comparison. The packet does not define what Report means for these quarterly grab-sampled pollutants. Footnote *6 illustrates Report semantics for TDS (geometric mean of weekly composite values), but no analogous footnote appears for Cadmium. The column-header versus sample-type tension (7-DAY AVG column with Grab sampling) is visible in comparable rows but does not establish either interpretive branch. Neither identity of the reporting obligation nor exclusion of 7-day average evaluation can be grounded from the available evidence, so unsupported semantic closure is avoided.
